_about: Each policy object is defined once here and referenced by name everywhere. A full policy is a queue rule plus a routing rule. Codes: A CTAS (1-5), B predicted service class (1 very long .. 5 very short), C predicted admission (1 admit, 2 discharge), D predicted diagnostics (1 yes, 2 no), E predicted resource use (1 three or more, 2 two, 3 one, 4 none), F predicted consult (1 yes, 2 no). Ranges R = (4, 4, 1, 1, 3, 1). Ties are always broken first-come-first-served (time the patient joined the queue, then patient id).
safety_rule: CTAS 1 patients are served before all others at every queue, under every rule.

CTAS.label: CTAS
CTAS.description: strict CTAS priority, FCFS within level

APQ.label: APQ
APQ.description: accumulating priority: wait divided by the CTAS target; serve the largest
APQ.source: StanfordTaylorZiedins2014_APQ; accumulation rate 1/target is our choice

CTAS-SPT.label: CTAS-SPT
CTAS-SPT.description: CTAS priority, then shortest predicted service

CTAS-PD.label: CTAS-PD
CTAS-PD.description: CTAS priority, then predicted discharge first

SIM.label: SIM
SIM.description: multi-attribute similarity to a target code (acuity first, then quick and simple patients); weights after the IISE multi-attribute policy

SIM-AGE.label: SIM-AGE
SIM-AGE.description: SIM plus an ageing term: 0.10 per elapsed CTAS target time

STREAM-PRED.label: Prediction streaming
STREAM-PRED.description: CTAS 3-5 with predicted discharge and predicted service class 4-5 to the second area

STREAM-SIM.label: Similarity routing
STREAM-SIM.description: CTAS 3-5 to the area whose target code is more similar; ties to Main

similarity_representations._about: Similarity-rule settings that Propositions 1-3 say reproduce a coded rule exactly (or, for SIM vs CTAS-SPT, only approximately). Used in the fidelity experiment E3.

SIMREP-NEAR.description: equal weights on CTAS and service: violates the lexicographic condition

SIM.description: the SIM rule above, compared with the rule it is often read as

default_policy.source: common practice: CTAS order with CTAS-based fast track
